item.title: Seattle weather: Drier skies by Monday night
item.description: More sunshine and mild days ahead, with Tuesday afternoon nearing 60 degrees! Plenty of sunshine as we head into the weekend with afternoons in the 50s.

item.title: WA man sentenced to 32 years for brutal stabbing of Kirkland woman
item.description: Prosecutors said Kevin Harper attacked the victim at her home after she complained about his work, stabbing and robbing her before leaving her for dead.

item.title: Businesses in Seattle’s Pioneer Square gear up for Seahawks playoff game
item.description: As fans gear up for Saturday’s big game against the San Francisco 49ers, so are some businesses in Pioneer Square, Seattle’s original neighborhood.

item.title: Budget the 'dominating' topic during Washington's legislative session
item.description: Pomp, circumstance, and a desire to get right to work: Washington's lawmakers are keenly focused on the budget as the legislative session began on Monday.

item.title: Chairlift stops at WA's Summit at Snoqualmie, forcing rope evacuation
item.description: Riders were forced to evacuate a chairlift at the Summit at Snoqualmie after it stopped running Sunday morning, according to a Snoqualmie Pass resident who watched the rescue unfold in real time.

item.title: Crook steals thousands worth of Pokemon cards from Everett, WA store
item.description: Surveillance cameras captured video of a thief smashing into a small business in Everett and making off with thousands of dollars’ worth of Pokémon cards.

item.title: 2 people found dead inside Mason County, WA home
item.description: Two people were found dead inside a Mason County home Monday morning, and an investigation remains underway.

item.title: Seattle Kraken score four unanswered goals to beat NY Rangers 4-2
item.description: Berkly Catton scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period, and the Seattle Kraken rallied from two goals down and beat the New York Rangers 4-2 on Monday night.

item.title: Mike Macdonald happy to be done watching games, now preparing Seattle Seahawks for 49ers rematch
item.description: Seattle Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald watched this weekend's playoff games across the NFL just like everyone else. And he's happy to be done with it.

item.title: Puppies revived after possible fentanyl exposure in Gold Bar, WA
item.description: Six puppies were rescued in Gold Bar after deputies said they were possibly exposed to fentanyl and nearly died.
